sentences.text:
CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC COURT,
DAVANAGERE DIST., DAVANAGERE.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Petitioners who are apprehending arrest in Crime No.76/2023 registered by Basavanagar police station, Davanagere for the offences punishable under Section 341, 323, 419, 420, 468, 471, 504 of IPC are before this Court under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. On the basis of the complaint dated 14.07.2023 lodged by Shabbir Ahamed son of late Allabhakshi Sab H., Station officer of Basavanagar police station, Davanagere has registered FIR in crime No.76/2023 against the first NC: 2023:KHC:41285 petitioner herein and other unknown person for the aforesaid offences.
In the complaint it is averred that, the land bearing Re.Sy.No.98/4 measuring 3 acres is the joint family property of the complainant, and on 29.05.2023 he had visited the said property.

Accused No.1 allegedly informed him that he had purchased the said property under a registered sale deed dated 15.04.2011 and accordingly had objected the complainant visiting the property and also had abused him.

On verification from the office of Sub-Registrar, complainant subsequently came to know that his family members in collusion with accused No.1 had executed a sale deed in respect of the property in question in favour of accused No.1 and revenue records of the lands were also transferred in the name of accused No.1.
He has alleged that the sale deed was executed by impersonation and accordingly, had approached the police and lodged the complaint.

Apprehending arrest in the said case petitioners had approached the Court of I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Davanagere in Crl.Mis.No.983/2023 which was NC: 2023:KHC:41285 rejected on 23.08.2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that, petitioner No.2 is the son of petitioner No.1.
The complaint averments would go to show that the family members of the complainant have joined the accused persons for executing the sale deed dated 15.04.2011.
Undisputedly there is a civil dispute between the family members of the complainant.
Petitioners have no criminal antecedents, they are ready and willing to co-operate with the investigation officer.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, the learned HCGP has opposed the bail application and he submits that investigation of this case is under progress.
Accordingly, prays to dismiss the petition.
6. From a reading of the complaint averments, it is seen that the property in question is undisputedly a joint NC: 2023:KHC:41285 family property.

In the complaint itself it is averred that the family members of the complainant have joined the accused persons in executing the registered sale deed dated 15.04.2011.
7.
The material on record would also go to show that there are number of civil litigations pending between the members of the family of the complainant.
The petitioners who have no criminal antecedents have undertaken to co-operate with the investigation officer for the purpose of investigation.
The alleged offences are triable by the Court of Magistrate and maximum punishment for the said offences is imprisonment for a period of 7 years.
8. Under these circumstances, I am of the opinion that the petitioners have made out a prima facie case for grant of anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER
The petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioner in the event of his arrest in Crime No.76/2023 registered by Basavanagar police station for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 419, 420, 468, 471 and 504 of IPC subject to the following conditions:
1. The Petitioners shall appear before the investigation officer on 25.11.2023 at 10:30 am and if, necessary the investigation officer shall take them to custody for the purpose of interrogation and thereafter, release them on the same date on or before 6:00 pm.
2. The petitioners shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
3. The petitioners shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.
